checkpoints.name: Project Setup
checkpoints.scope: Create the feature branch, add baseline scaffolding, document conventions in docs/implementation_plan.md.
exit_criteria: Feature branch exists and is checked out
checkpoints.review_notes: Approved. Branch created and plan documented.

checkpoints.name: Implement Core Package
checkpoints.scope: Build the main feature package per the plan. Include unit tests.
exit_criteria: Package compiles cleanly with go build ./...
Unit tests cover the public API
checkpoints.review_notes: Built. Files added: internal/feature/*.go, internal/feature/*_test.go. Awaiting reviewer.

checkpoints.name: Wire Into Main
checkpoints.scope: Expose the new package through the main entry point and add an integration test.
exit_criteria: Binary builds and runs without errors
Integration test covers the end-to-end happy path
